headline: Chardan Initiates MoonLake with Buy Rating on Drug Prospects
summary: Chardan initiated coverage on MoonLake stock with a buy rating, citing the outlook for its hydradenitis suppurativa drug.
why: Initial analyst coverage and clinical pipeline prospects heavily influence investor sentiment and valuation for clinical-stage biopharmaceutical firms.

impacts.name: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics
impacts.why: A buy initiation from an investment firm can attract new investor capital and support the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
